acquisition.derivation: full-volume FP64 linear HU resampling with edge clamping, identical voxel-face corners
acquisition.coordinate_frame: RAS mm, world-Z circular acquisition, zero-view source centre-(0,600,0), rows +Z
acquisition.pose: identity for main comparison, no transforms inferred from filenames
acquisition.pilot_views: Full 360-view rotation for screening. No first-16-view inference.

field.model: max(1+resampled_HU/1000,0)*0.02059 evaluated FP64 then one FP32 cast

sampling.rule: uniform midpoints on each ray clipped to voxel-face support
sampling.interpolation: trilinear with constant boundary-sample extension inside support
sampling.fp64: FP32 stored field, FP64 interpolation and accumulation, FP64 output
sampling.fp32: FP32 stored field, local sample arithmetic, interpolation and accumulation, FP32 output

cotangent.normalisation: compute each raw value and global L1 sum in FP64, divide in FP64 then cast once FP32
cotangent.purpose: dense positive smooth asymmetric detector objective, all backends consume the same saved FP32 values
cotangent.fp64_use: cast the exact saved FP32 seed to FP64, do not recompute or renormalise
cotangent.pilot_use: Use all 360 views of the globally normalised saved seed without renormalising
cotangent.binding: record and verify both file and raw-value SHA256 in every result before any timing

operations.forward: ordinary Projector with resident FP32 field and fixed identity geometry, output allocation included
operations.volume_vjp: torch.autograd.grad on a retained fixed graph with only the field requiring gradients, output gradient allocation included
operations.pose_vjp: torch.autograd.grad on a retained fixed graph with only FP64 right-tangent pose requiring gradients, output gradient allocation included
operations.iteration: fresh ordinary Projector forward plus torch.autograd.grad for both field and FP64 pose, no accumulation in .grad
operations.wall_boundary: completed resident call, input upload, CPU checks and file writes excluded, actual internal validation/synchronisation included
operations.event_boundary: CUDA events on current Torch execution stream, Projector Warp stream bridges must include work before ending event
operations.volume_iteration: fresh ordinary Projector forward plus torch.autograd.grad for field alone, no accumulation

timing.warmup: first exact operation and one completed pilot before each timing series
timing.raw_samples: save every wall/event sample with per-round UTC timestamps
timing.memory: Torch allocator peaks plus sampled NVML process/device memory, NVML peaks are lower bounds
timing.headline: clean runs outside profiler, no overlapping timed GPU jobs

same_mode_image.scope: candidate versus unchanged-kernel baseline with identical input/views

pose_fd.status: separate asymmetric nonidentity guard, not a claim from identity fullscan inner products
pose_fd.guard_configuration: See fullscan_guards.json for fixed views, pose direction and selected steps.

quality.failure_policy: retain actual failure and stop candidate claims, do not loosen thresholds after observations
